interface.title: Temperature Analyser v1.0
interface.field: Petroleum / geothermal exploration geology (borehole thermal analysis)
interface.stage_of_work: Well planning (pre-drill prediction) and post-drill evaluation of logging data
interface.what_it_is_for: Register a vertical exploration well, predict its P90/P50/P10 temperature-depth profile before drilling, and correct measured bottom-hole temperatures after drilling (AAPG and Harrison 1983) so the two can be compared.

data.note: There is no example or upload. I typed every value: Test-Well-A (onshore, KB 35 m, GL 30 m, 15 °C), gradients 25/30/35 °C/km, TD 3000 m, then six MD/BHT runs from 1000 m/130 °F to 3000 m/230 °F. Later the same form was re-entered as offshore Test-Well-B (KB 25 m, water depth 400 m, sea floor 4 °C). The app holds one well at a time, so this replaced Test-Well-A. Values persist across tabs. The Input Check and '?' buttons report through browser confirm dialogs, which no kept screen shows; their texts are confirmed only by the replay's notes. The Pre-drill and Post-drill tabs re-ran by themselves when re-entered after the well registration changed (screens/035.webp, screens/037.webp).

features.name: Single-site metadata form with validation dialog and shared downstream context
features.general: Fill in a small set of site parameters, pick the site type, and press a check button that pops up either a pass message or the rule that was broken; the one stored site feeds every analysis tab, which re-runs when the site changes
features.specific: Well registration: name, Onshore/Offshore radio, KB, GL/water depth and surface/sea-floor temperature; Input Check confirms or warns 'KB can not be lower than GL for onshore wells!' (the dialog often lags one press, showing 'null' first). Only one well is held; re-entering replaces it, and the Pre-drill and Post-drill tabs re-run for it when reopened
steps: read the pass or warning dialog and fix the inputs
reopen the analysis tabs, which have re-run for the new site, and press Calculate & Display to clear stale output
serves_tasks: Enter site metadata and check it is consistent
Describe an offshore site instead (replaces the current site)
Correct the measurements for an offshore site

features.name: Scenario (P90/P50/P10) profile forecaster with site-dependent depth-datum selector
features.general: Enter low/mid/high gradient scenarios and a total depth, check they are in order, and get a table and a depth-versus-value chart with one line per scenario; a depth-reference selector, whose options depend on the site type, re-references only the chart's depth axis
features.specific: Pre-drill prediction: P90/P50/P10 °C/km and TD, '?' order check, Calculate & Display fills the table and the 'Temperature prediction graph'. Depth Type offers TVDgl/TVDkb onshore and only TVDbml offshore; it changes only the plot's depth axis, while the table stays in TVDgl (onshore) or TVDbml (offshore)
steps: type the three gradients and TD
choose the depth type for the plot axis
press Calculate & Display (again after any change, to clear stale rows)
read the table and hover points on the plot
serves_tasks: Validation sub-step: check that the low/mid/high scenario inputs are in order
Compute and plot the scenario profiles against depth

features.name: Multi-run measurement correction with twin temperature and gradient plots
features.general: Enter up to six depth/value readings, check they are in depth order, re-reference the depths to the site datum, apply two correction methods, and see a table plus paired plots of corrected values and interval gradients against depth
features.specific: Post-drill analysis: Run 1–6 MD (m)/BHT (°F), Input Check for md1<…<md6 (valid input only ever gives 'null'), Calculate & Display converts MD to TVDgl (onshore) or TVDbml (offshore) using KB and GL/water depth and gives a TVD/AAPG/Harrison/gradient table and the 'Post-drill temperature analysis' and 'geothermal gradient analysis' plots
steps: type MD and BHT for each run
compare the AAPG and Harrison curves in both plots
serves_tasks: Enter measurements by depth and check they are in depth order
Correct the measurements by two methods and plot temperatures and gradients
Correct the measurements for an offshore site

features.specific: Change Colours dropdowns for P90/P50/P10 (applied immediately) and AAPG/Harr. (applied on the next Calculate & Display)
steps: press Calculate & Display if the plot did not update
serves_tasks: Compute and plot the scenario profiles against depth
Correct the measurements by two methods and plot temperatures and gradients
Correct the measurements for an offshore site

features.name: Interactive depth plot with zoom and PNG export (library-provided Plotly toolbar)

press the camera icon to download a PNG
